Interface StackedProtocolObject

All Known Implementing Classes:
ElectricalPower, ForceNewtons, SysMLSignal, ViscousResistanceNewtons
public interface StackedProtocolObject
Interface specification for an object that is encapsulated in another object which is part of a protocol "stack". The interface requires services on the implementing object to include methods to return a "stack" of names of the objects in the nested encapsulations of the protocol objects. The stack of names serves to display the protocol objects as nested layers of information corresponding to their position in the "stack". For instance, a typical world-wide web protocol stack would show the nested encapsulations of the protocols in the stack and might appear as follows: 
       EthernetPacket[IPPacket[TCPPacket[HTTPResponse[HTMLDoc]]]]

    • stackNamesString

      default String stackNamesString()

      String representation of the object stack names

    • stackNamesString

      default String stackNamesString(SysMLAnything namedClass, Optional<StackedProtocolObject> next)
      Default implementation of method to be called by required method above to produce a stack names string (instead of a simple class name string). This method will call the stackNamesString() operation for the "next" object in the stack to produce its stackNamesString, thereby using reentrancy to build the entire stack of names of objects in the protocol stack.
      Parameters:
      namedClass - object that is the current point in the "stack" of objects. If this object (in the stack of protocol objects) has a name, the name is used, but if not, the object's class name is used.
      next - StackedProtocolObject that is the "next" object in the stack.
      Returns:
      String representation of the protocol stack's object names.
